mapper.select: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(p.id) AS product_cnt, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(p.price), 0), 2) AS avg_price, COALESCE(MAX(p.price), 0) AS max_price, COALESCE(MIN(p.price), 0) AS min_price FROM category c LEFT JOIN product p ON c.id = p.category_id AND p.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY product_cnt DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN price < 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN price >= 20 AND price < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mid_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN price >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total FROM product WHERE status = 1
